title: A scalable e-commerce platform with inventory sync and multi-channel selling
summary: An e-commerce foundation that connects inventory, payment gateways and multiple sales channels without flattening the brand's personality.

overview: A resilient storefront with inventory sync, multiple payment gateways and multi-channel support, designed around a brand with a strong point of view.
